1.title: Fédéral Tax esengaka
1.description: Kolaka biso ya fédéral tax na Amerika.
1.content:
## Base ya Fédéral Tax

### État ya Filing
- Monene (Single)
- Mwenyio ya Kolelwa (Married Filing Jointly)
- Mwenyio ya Kolabana (Married Filing Separately)
- Motema ya Ndako (Head of Household)

### Brackets ya Mukomba
- 10%: $0 - $11,000
- 12%: $11,001 - $44,725
- 22%: $44,726 - $95,375
- 24%: $95,376 - $182,100
- 32%: $182,101 - $231,250
- 35%: $231,251 - $578,125
- 37%: $578,126+

### Tax Credit
- Child Tax Credit
- Earned Income Tax Credit
- Education Credits

### Siku ya Filing
- 15 Avrilaka mbala nzambe
- 6 misi ya boyokani
- Online okangama na poto

### Malako
1. Yomba état ya monene
2. Mukomba wese kolakisa
3. Documents boyebaka
4. Filing na ntango
5. Kolamba mosalisi ya tax

### Ebandaka Epai
- Kolakisa mukomba
- Boyekoli ya filing
- Documents ezo na boyokani

2.title: Kolakisa Tax Return
2.description: Ndenge ya kolakisa tax return na molayi.
2.content:
## Tax Return Filing

### Documents Ezali
- W-2 (ya salaire)
- 1099 (ya freelance/bisungu)
- 1098 (ya ekolo/ndako)
- Social Security Number (SSN) okanda ITIN

### Ndenge ya Filing

**Online:**
- IRS Free File
- TurboTax
- H&R Block
- TaxAct

**Na Poto:**
- Form ya papier
- Na ntango ya monene

### Processus
1. Documents ezali kolakisa
2. État ya monene
3. Déduction esengaka (Standard okanda Itemized)
4. Credit eko apply
5. Tax ezali kolakisa
6. Filing na payement

### Malako
1. Filing online - ya monene na boyebo
2. IRS Free File ($73,000 na komi ya mokomba)
3. Documents ezali kolakisa
4. Filing na ntango
5. Direct deposit boyebaka

### Ebandaka Epai
- Filing na poto: ya monene
- Documents eko salaka
- Boyokani eko salaka

- Ekosala ya childcare

### Avantage
